subject: Short-window headroom request and amortized overrun plan
messages:
From: Tom Riley <tom.riley@launchio.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Park <elena.park@brightcart.com>
Date: 2028-05-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Short-term QPS buffer request for launch spike

Sofia —

We’re ramping our new checkout flow next week and need a short-window (6–12 hour) QPS buffer on day-of-launch. Forecast attached — peak looks like ~4.5x our baseline for a 3 hour window, then tapering.

Quick asks: can Redwood provision a temporary headroom for that window? If so:
- What’s the uplift rate we’d pay for the temporary capacity?
- Can overrun be handled via a one-off true-up, or do you require a committed tier change?

We’d prefer not to renegotiate our annual commit for a 3-hour spike; happy to pay a higher short-term rate. Also curious whether you can amortize any overrun charge across the next 3 invoices — would help our finance team.

Appreciate a quick read — launch is Tuesday 5/30.

Thanks,
Tom Riley
Head of Engineering, Launchio
Attachment: launchio_traffic_forecast_Q2.xlsx

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Tom Riley <tom.riley@launchio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-22T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term QPS buffer request for launch spike

Tom — thanks for the forecast, that helps. We can absolutely cover a short-window uplift using our ephemeral headroom lanes. High-level options:

1) Ephemeral uplift (preferred for spikes)
   - Provisioned for the requested window, billed at a premium uplift rate (we normally quote a 2.5x per-token uplift for <24h transient capacity).
   - No commit required; immediate availability subject to capacity at time-of-request.

2) Short-term reserved burst (for repeated spikes)
   - Reserve a small dedicated pool for a defined period (7–30 days) at a lower uplift multiple.

Regarding overrun handling: we can do a one-off overrun true-up. On amortization: finance is typically conservative on multi-month amortization, but we can make an exception as a commercial concession for pilots. Draft commercial proposal below:
- Approve ephemeral uplift for the launch window at 2.25x baseline rate (pilot concession).
- Any measured overrun beyond the uplift entitlement will be invoiced, but Redwood will amortize the overrun across the next 3 invoices (equal installments).
- Cap on amortized amount: we can agree to amortize up to $50k; amounts above that require PO or prepayment.

I’m looping in Ben (pricing) and Marissa (finance) to confirm we can surface this in the SOW. If you’re ok with the above, I’ll prepare a short addendum and DocuSign link.

Cheers,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0199
Attachment: —

Sofia —

Thanks for the fast reply and the concession offer. A couple of clarifying items from our CFO: 
- Can you confirm the exact uplift multiplier in dollars (example: if baseline is $0.008/token, what would the uplift rate be)?
- The $50k amortization cap — can we stretch to $75k for this one-off? The launch is pivotal and our payment runway is short.

If you can do 2.25x at the token level and bump the amortization cap to $75k, we can sign the addendum and route a PO immediately. Otherwise we’ll likely need to prepay the estimated overrun.

Also, please include a one-line in the addendum that the ephemeral uplift will not change our baseline committed tier or renewal terms.

Best,
Tom

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: 2028-05-24T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Short-term QPS buffer request for launch spike

Looping in commercial approvals — we reviewed and can do the following concession for Launchio as a pilot customer: 

- Uplift price: 2.25x their current per-token baseline. Example language for addendum: "Transient Headroom Rate = 2.25 × Customer Baseline per-token rate for the duration of the approved uplift window."
- Amortization cap: increased to $75,000 for this event only. Any true-up exceeding that amount will require an approved PO or immediate payment.
- Contract language: add a single clause stating the ephemeral uplift does not modify ongoing committed tiers, renewal mechanics, or future pricing.

Marissa — please prepare the one-page addendum and include DocuSign link. Sofia — you can confirm to Tom and Elena; include the HubSpot deal id and attach the signed addendum to the deal record.

Ben Carter
Director, Commercials — Redwood Inference
